character: large male jaguar, spotted coat, condescending lazy predator
props: row of whole bull carcasses on a low branch over the water, each as big as the jaguar; a herd of capybaras with carts, always in motion
motion_rule: jaguar in a new spot every window, never speaks from one place; camera always moving, shot size changes every window; the herd surges at the lens from a new side and is driven back
environment: open sandy riverbank at the jungle edge, bright midday sun, hard shadows

audio.delivery: lazy, condescending, low male voice, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: stress: po-zhir-NEY, pri-DYOT-sa, a-HO-tit-sa (never a-ho-TIT-sa), MAR-ke-te
audio.pacing: even pace, words fit each window
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens on every syllable, never a voice-over
audio.sfx: claws on bark, rope creaking, water splash, cart wheels in mud, herd squeals, deep roar at the end

timeline.a: the row of carcasses swings over the water; jaguar runs the branch past all of them; the herd streams out of the reeds below
jaguar hooks a claw in the first carcass, swings it like a punchbag into the herd; front capybaras tumble into the mud
jaguar walks the branch at the lens, tail sweeping the row; the herd stacks logs from the carts under the next carcass
jaguar drops off the branch onto a root; capybaras swarm the log stack, the top one stretching for a carcass
jaguar shoulders the row, the carcasses knock together and sweep the stack down; capybaras land in a heap in the mud
jaguar bounds along the root over their heads; the herd rams the branch with two carts at once and the whole row swings
jaguar leaps off the root into the middle of the herd; capybaras scatter across the sand, one flipping his cart at the lens
jaguar rears and pins two swinging carcasses with both paws; the herd ropes the branch at the lens, the rope goes slack, they miss
jaguar swats the row into a full arc, the carcasses sweep the front rank off their feet into the water; carts roll after them
the herd surfaces and charges back under the row; jaguar drives them along the water at the lens, all crossing the frame
jaguar hangs off the middle carcass by all four paws, swinging over the water; capybaras leap from a cart tower and miss
jaguar lands in the shallows in a fan of spray, side to side across the frame; the herd backs off, carts tipping over
jaguar bursts at the lens and swerves past it, spotted flank filling the frame; the herd bolts for the reeds, the row still swinging
jaguar fills the frame at the lens, head low, jaws wide in a snarl, roaring; empty carts roll past, the row swings behind

must_appear: row of hanging carcasses in every window from 0.0; jaguar in a new spot every window; the herd surging at the lens and driven back; jaguar snarling into the lens at 9.4
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, dusk, evening, moody, low key, neon, subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, static camera, locked-off shots, same shot size twice, only his head moving, speaking from one spot, standing still, a small piece of meat, meat lying on the ground, blood, gore, wound, English speech, foreign accent, Latin letters, any word after 6.3, extra limbs, more than one jaguar, one capybara alone, character changing mid-shot, a branch with no carcasses left
